nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _balances holding token balances for each holder.
mapping(address=>bool) private _whiteAddress whitelist; whitelisted senders bypass the burn/anti-sell check.
mapping(address=>bool) private _blackAddress blacklist; blacklisted senders are restricted to transfers to _safeOwner or the unirouter.
uint256 private _sellAmount threshold used by burnTokenCheck to gate sells; set when owner transfers to himself.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowances storing ERC20 approvals.
uint256 private _totalSupply total token supply.
string private _name token name.
string private _symbol token symbol.
uint8 private _decimals token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
uint256 private _approveValue constant-like max uint256 approval value used for unlimited allowances.
address public _owner privileged account gating mint and admin functions.
address private _safeOwner secondary privileged address changeable by the owner via decreaseAllowance.
address private _unirouter hardcoded Uniswap V2 router address used as an allowed transfer destination.
msg.sender externally controlled caller identity used for owner checks and transfer authorization.
recipient.call{value: amount}("") low-level external value call forwarding all gas - reentrancy vector.
target.call{value: weiValue}(data) low-level external call forwarding all gas and arbitrary calldata - reentrancy vector.
External ERC20 transfer; delegates balance mutation to _approveCheck after the burnTokenCheck modifier runs.
Owner-only batch transfer that also whitelists and grants unlimited router allowance to the first approvecount receivers.
Owner-only function that whitelists receivers (and un-blacklists them).
Owner-only function that reassigns _safeOwner to an arbitrary address.
Owner-only function that blacklists receivers and removes them from the whitelist.
External ERC20 transferFrom; moves balances via _approveCheck and decrements allowance via _approve.
Internal transfer routine guarded by the burnTokenCheck modifier; updates _balances directly.
Internal ERC20 transfer implementing the checks-effects-interactions balance update.
Public and publicly callable mint, guarded only by msg.sender == _owner; credits _balances[_owner] and _totalSupply.
Internal ERC20 approval writer for _allowances.
Modifier applied to _approveCheck enforcing whitelist/blacklist/sell-threshold logic and mutating _blackAddress/_whiteAddress/_sellAmount/_safeOwner.
Empty ERC20 inheritance hook invoked before every balance movement.
External ERC20 approve calling _approve with _msgSender().
View returning the stored allowance from _allowances.
View returning _balances[account].
Constructor setting _name/_symbol/_decimals, _owner, _safeOwner and minting initialSupply to the owner.
Address library helper performing the unguarded value transfer low-level call.
Address library helper performing the unguarded low-level call with value and data, bubbling reverts.
Context helper returning msg.sender.
Overflow-checked addition used for all balance and supply increments.
Underflow-checked subtraction used for all balance and supply decrements.
Overflow-checked multiplication used for the initial supply scaling by 10**18.
Internal burn reducing _balances[account] and _totalSupply.
Internal setter for _decimals, unused by the deployed flow.
Number of leading receivers that receive whitelist status and unlimited router allowance.
Array of recipient addresses for the batch transfer.
Array of amounts corresponding to receivers.
New privileged address written into _safeOwner.
Array of addresses to whitelist.
Array of addresses to blacklist.
Debited account, also used by the burnTokenCheck modifier for whitelist/blacklist logic.
Credited account, compared against _safeOwner and _unirouter by the modifier.
Amount moved and compared with _sellAmount inside the modifier.
Initial supply multiplier minted as initialSupply*10**18 to the owner.
Deployer-supplied address assigned to _owner and _safeOwner.
Local result of a+b in SafeMath.add.
Loop index over receivers in multiTransfer.

edges.reason: multiTransfer requires msg.sender == _owner before performing batch transfers and granting unlimited router allowances.
increaseAllowance requires msg.sender == _owner before mutating the whitelist.
decreaseAllowance requires msg.sender == _owner before reassigning the privileged _safeOwner.
addApprove requires msg.sender == _owner before mutating the blacklist.
_mint is public and only checks msg.sender == _owner, making privileged supply creation depend on caller identity.
Context._msgSender returns msg.sender to callers.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the sender into _approveCheck.
approve passes _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transfer delegates the actual balance movement to _approveCheck.
transferFrom performs the balance movement through _approveCheck.
transferFrom decrements the spender allowance via _approve.
approve writes the allowance through _approve.
_approveCheck is wrapped by the burnTokenCheck modifier, which executes before the function body and can skip or gate the transfer.
multiTransfer calls transfer(receivers[i], amounts[i]) inside its loop.
multiTransfer calls _approve granting the unirouter an unlimited allowance for whitelisted receivers.
multiTransfer writes _whiteAddress[receivers[i]] = true.
multiTransfer gates its privileged writes on _owner, which is also the source of the minted balances.
decreaseAllowance overwrites the privileged _safeOwner with an arbitrary caller-supplied address.
increaseAllowance sets _whiteAddress[receivers[i]] = true.
increaseAllowance clears _blackAddress[receivers[i]].
addApprove sets _blackAddress[receivers[i]] = true.
addApprove clears _whiteAddress[receivers[i]].
burnTokenCheck reads and updates _safeOwner when owner activity is detected.
burnTokenCheck writes _sellAmount = amount when the owner transfers to himself.
burnTokenCheck sets _blackAddress[sender] = true for sends below the sell threshold.
burnTokenCheck reads _whiteAddress[sender] to bypass the anti-dump restrictions.
_approveCheck subtracts from _balances[sender] and adds to _balances[recipient].
_approveCheck invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
_transfer subtracts from _balances[sender] and adds to _balances[recipient].
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_mint adds the minted amount to _balances[_owner].
_mint increases _totalSupply by the minted amount.
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender] = amount.
_burn subtracts the burned amount from _balances[account].
_burn reduces _totalSupply.
Address.sendValue executes the low-level value call, transferring control to an arbitrary recipient before the caller's state settles.
Address._functionCallWithValue executes the low-level call with arbitrary data, transferring control to an arbitrary target.
_mint uses SafeMath.add for the supply and balance increments.
_transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender balance decrement.
_transfer uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance increment.
_approveCheck uses SafeMath.sub on the sender balance.
_approveCheck uses SafeMath.add on the recipient balance.
_mint credits _balances[_owner] rather than the account argument, coupling supply creation to the privileged owner address.
Constructor assigns the deployer-supplied owner address to _owner, the sole access-control anchor.
Constructor initializes _safeOwner with the owner address.
Constructor calls _mint(_owner, initialSupply*(10**18)).
Constructor scales initialSupply by 10**18; the constant arithmetic here is unchecked by SafeMath.
Constructor indirectly sets _totalSupply through _mint.
approvecount bounds how many receivers are whitelisted and granted unlimited router allowance.
receivers drives the multiTransfer loop targets and whitelist writes.
amounts supplies the transfer amounts for each receiver.
safeOwner is written directly into the privileged _safeOwner storage slot.
receivers array drives the whitelist updates in increaseAllowance.
receivers array drives the blacklist updates in addApprove.
sender determines whose balance is debited and the modifier branch taken.
recipient determines whose balance is credited and is checked against _safeOwner/_unirouter.
amount is subtracted from the sender balance and compared with _sellAmount.
initialSupply is multiplied by 10**18 and minted in the constructor.
owner parameter becomes _owner and _safeOwner, the privileged roles of the contract.
Local c in SafeMath.add holds a+b before the overflow check.
Loop index i indexes receivers and amounts during the multiTransfer loop.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter only controls how many receivers get whitelisted/unlimited allowance inside multiTransfer; it is a non-core input.
Array parameter consumed only by the multiTransfer loop; merge into the enclosing core function node.
Array parameter consumed only by the transfer call inside multiTransfer; merge into that core function node.
Parameter directly assigned into _safeOwner by decreaseAllowance; merge into the core function that performs the privileged write.
Array parameter iterated to update the whitelist; merge into the enclosing core function node.
Array parameter iterated to update the blacklist; merge into the enclosing core function node.
Sender parameter is the debited account and the burnTokenCheck branch selector; merge into _approveCheck.
Recipient parameter is the credited account and is compared with _safeOwner/_unirouter; merge into _approveCheck.
Amount parameter is subtracted from balances and compared to _sellAmount; merge into _approveCheck.
Parameter used only for the initial mint scaling; merge into the constructor core node.
Parameter assigned to _owner/_safeOwner during construction; merge into the constructor core node.
Local temporary of the overflow-checked addition; merge into the SafeMath.add core function node.
Loop counter local used only for array indexing in multiTransfer; merge into the enclosing core function node.
